three_car_service_no_tension.basis: Compression-positive sampled gross-section full-force straight-tendon research diagnostic; not material/code acceptance

transfer_no_tension.basis: Compression-positive sampled gross-section full-force straight-tendon research diagnostic; not material/code acceptance

bed_and_mould.basis: Increased bed force/return axis, strongback, restraint, foundations and split mould stiffness/access need actual redesign

demould_route.basis: End diaphragms obstruct longitudinal core withdrawal; split removable or collapsible intrados forms, draft, clearance and demould/lift trials require explicit tooling design

end_zone.basis: Full force at beam ends is diagnostic; transmission, bond, bursting and anchorage qualification absent

lifting_and_transport.basis: Insert/breakout resistance, unequal sharing, tilt, suction, wind, full rig mass, accepted rig configuration and route absent

manufacturing_qualification.basis: Rebar/grip/jack access, tolerances, process trials, curing/transfer strength, traceability and qualified suppliers absent

material_limits.basis: Concrete/strand transfer and service resistances and timed losses absent

shear_fatigue_deflection.basis: Reinforcement, shear, torsion, cracking, fatigue, deflection/camber and dynamic interaction unresolved

six_car_loading.basis: Accepted six-car axle allocation, dynamic factors and load combinations absent

track_and_substructure.basis: Rail fastening, bearings, seismic/site/geotechnical and civil interfaces unresolved

design_space.basis: Explicit bounded OSR geometry/process hypotheses, not accepted project tolerances, material allowables or certified equipment capacities. The 125 t handling envelope is only the existing runway research reservation. Rectangular zero-draft cast envelopes require split removable forms, actual supplier review and demould trials.

limitations: Search passes are conditional research screens only; unknown gates remain unknown and are excluded from conditional ranking
41 railway stations; expanded handling stations include exact gravity moment extrema but fibre stresses remain sampled
Gross uncracked prismatic concrete, simultaneous straight pretensioning and inherited research elastic/loss properties; no code/material resistance adoption
Known mass excludes conventional reinforcement/attachments; 2 t rigging is a retained assumption
New geometries and strand counts require new moulds, stressing bed, strongback and supplier integration; current native bed is not requalified
search_method: deterministic failure-prioritised breadth-first bounded neighbour search
